Ofwat has provisionally approved 13 water companies to increase bills by £3.4bn to fund infrastructure upgrades, growth, and pollution control, sparking significant public and political backlash.

The error is in the WHO plane; they frame this as a 'growth' necessity (WHAT) while ignoring the 'who' (the families struggling with costs).

This is a classic case of maintaining conflict to preserve authority. By framing failure as an 'insurmountable mountain' of infrastructure needs, they justify extraction.
